text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On my lunch break, I look for Mejiro McQueen to discuss her training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… It seems I can't do it after all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Ahh! Trainer! How long have you been standing there?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gulp! But still… you s-saw my… terrible dancing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please know I don't usually dance this poorly! I'm just… unaccustomed to pop music.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Be that as it may, I must live up to expectations atop the stage as well as on the racecourse. That is a mark of a true Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No need to worry. I will be dancing like a star in no time!
choice_data_list: I can help you with your practice if you'd like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… But that look on your face… I can see that nothing I say will sway you. Good grief, you are quite the worrywart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-well then… Um… If I make a fool of myself, please don't laugh at me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I join Mejiro McQueen in her training and help her master the dance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well… it's true I've been focused solely on the choreography. Perhaps that's why I'm not getting it quite right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm grateful for your advice. I shall start by reading the lyrics of the song!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From there, Mejiro McQueen deepens her understanding of the song, allowing her to master her dance with aplomb.
